setup.title: Setup — toascribe admin
setup.heading: Set up the site
setup.intro: Welcome to toascribe. Answer a few questions and the site is ready.

token.hint: The setup code is in the log of the api service, in the address that ends with “#token=”. Run {logs} to see the log. If you no longer have the code, {renew} makes a new one.
token.label: Setup code
token.help: The code works only for this setup, and stops working once the site is installed.
token.badAddress: The address held a setup code that cannot be right. Paste the code from the log instead.

validation.token: Paste the whole setup code from the log. It is made of letters, digits, hyphens and underscores, without spaces.
validation.title: Enter a title for the site, on one line and at most 200 characters.
validation.timezone: Choose a time zone from the list.
validation.host: Enter the address of the mail server, for example smtp.example.com.
validation.port: Enter a port number between 1 and 65535, or leave the field empty.
validation.smtpUsername: The username cannot contain line breaks and has at most 320 characters.
validation.fromName: The name must be on one line and have at most 200 characters.
validation.passwordSame: The password cannot be the same as the username or the email address.

check.intro: Before the site is set up, we check that the services around it are in order.
check.passed: The check is done, and everything that must be in order is.
check.failed: The check is done. Items to fix before you can continue: {n}.
check.blocked: Fix what is marked “Must be fixed”, restart the services if needed, and choose “Check again”. You cannot continue until everything is in order.

database.title: Database
database.problem: Cannot reach the database. Check that the “postgres” service is running and that the passwords in docker/.env are right, and restart the api service.

migrations.title: Database setup
migrations.ok: The database is up to date: {applied} of {expected} migrations have run.
migrations.problem: The database is not up to date: {applied} of {expected} migrations have run. Run the “migrate” service again and check again.

encryption.title: Encryption key
encryption.problem: TOASCRIBE_ENCRYPTION_KEY is missing or invalid. Make keys with “toa core gen-env”, put them in docker/.env and restart the services.

signing.title: Signing key
signing.problem: TOASCRIBE_SIGNING_KEY is missing, invalid or the same as the encryption key. Make keys with “toa core gen-env”, put them in docker/.env and restart the services.

origin.title: Web address
origin.ok: The browser uses {origin}, which is what PUBLIC_ORIGIN says.
origin.unknown: The address the browser uses could not be checked. PUBLIC_ORIGIN is {configured}.
origin.mismatch: The browser uses {observed}, but PUBLIC_ORIGIN is {configured}. Logging in and links in emails work on one of the addresses only. Correct PUBLIC_ORIGIN in docker/.env, restart the services and open the setup at the right address.

proxy.title: Proxy in front of the site
proxy.configured: TOASCRIBE_TRUSTED_PROXY is set. The visitors' addresses are read from your proxy.
proxy.ok: Visitors come from different addresses, so the proxy gives the right address for each of them.
proxy.watching: We are still looking at which addresses visitors come from ({n} requests so far). There is nothing you need to do now.
proxy.warning: TOASCRIBE_TRUSTED_PROXY is empty, and every request so far has come from the same internal address ({address}). All visitors then share one limit on login attempts, and the addresses in the log are the proxy's. Set the variable to the proxy's address in docker/.env and restart the proxy service. You can continue without doing it now.

site.intro: These are settings you can change later.
site.title: Site title
site.titleHelp: The name of the site. It is shown on the login screens and in emails from the site.

language.label: Site language
language.help: The language also decides the text of the default content made at the end.

timezone.label: Time zone
timezone.help: Choose your city or a city in the same time zone. You can type to search.

site.adminEmailHelp: The site sends notifications here. Visitors do not see the address.

visibility.label: Discourage search engines from indexing this site
visibility.help: It is up to search engines to honour this request.

email.intro: The site sends email, for example links to choose a new password. Fill in the mail server (SMTP) and send a test email to see that it works.
email.skippedBefore: You skipped email earlier. Fill in the form and send a test email if you want to set it up now.
email.portHelp: Leave the field empty to use the default port of the chosen encryption ({port}).
email.usernameHelp: Leave the field empty if the server does not require a login.
email.passwordKeep: A password is saved and is not shown. Leave the field empty to keep it, or type a new one.
email.passwordHelp: Leave the field empty if the server does not require a login. The password is stored encrypted and is not shown again.
email.fromAddressHelp: The address the email is sent from, for example site{'@'}example.com.
email.fromNameHelp: Optional. If you leave the field empty, the site title is used.

test.toHelp: The address gets a short message from the site.
test.sending: Saving and sending the test email …
test.sent: The test email has been sent to {to}. Check the inbox. You can continue.

failed.sendFailed: The mail server did not accept the message. Check the server, port, encryption, username and password, and try again.
failed.mailConfig: The email settings are incomplete. Fill in the server and the from address and try again.
failed.timeout: Sending took too long. Check that the server and port are right and that the worker service is running, and try again.
failed.queueUnavailable: The message did not get into the queue. Check that the database and the worker service are running, and try again.
failed.busy: A test email is already on its way. Wait a few seconds and try again.

email.mustTest: Send a test email first. You can continue once it is sent, or skip email below.

skip.heading: Skip email
skip.warning: If you skip, the site cannot send email, for example links to choose a new password, until you have set up email. The dashboard shows a notice about it until that is done.

admin.intro: This will be the first account, and it gets every right. When the setup is done, you are logged in with it.
admin.usernameHelp: 3 to 60 characters: letters and digits, and optionally full stops, underscores, hyphens or {'@'}.
admin.emailHelp: Used for notifications, and if you lose your password.

key.title: Recovery key
key.intro: The key protects the backups of the site, and you need it to move the site to a new server. Save it in a password manager, or print it and keep the paper.
key.once: We show the key only now. The server stores only a check value, so the key cannot be made again if you lose it. If you reload the page before the installation is done, we make a new key, and the old one stops working.
key.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the key and copy it by hand.
key.downloaded: The text file has been downloaded.
key.saved: I have saved the recovery key
key.mustConfirm: Confirm that you have saved the key to continue.

content.intro: As in WordPress, the site gets a little content to start with, so it is not empty. You can change or delete all of it later. This is made:
content.privacy: A draft privacy policy page, “{title}”, set as the site's privacy policy page.
content.outro: None of this is made until you finish the installation in the last step.

finish.intro: This is what will be set up. Check that it is right, and choose “Finish the installation”.
finish.searchDiscouraged: Search engines are asked not to index the site
finish.emailTested: Set up, and the test email has been sent
finish.emailSkipped: Skipped. A notice will remind you.
finish.keyValue: You have confirmed that it is saved
finish.working: Installing. This can take a few seconds …
finish.signin: The site is installed, but we could not log you in automatically. Log in with the username and password you chose.

notice.passwordChanged: Your password has been changed. You can now log in with the new password.
notice.checkEmail: Check your email. If the account exists, we have sent a link to choose a new password.
notice.registered: Your registration has been received. If the details were valid, you will get an email with a link to choose a password. If nothing arrives, the username may be taken, or you may already have an account.

validation.loginRequired: Enter your username or email address.
validation.newPassword: The password must have at least 8 characters.
validation.username: The username must have 3 to 60 characters: letters and digits, and optionally full stops, underscores, hyphens or {'@'}. It cannot contain spaces.
validation.email: Enter a valid email address, for example name{'@'}example.com.
validation.totpCode: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
validation.recoveryCode: Enter the whole recovery code, for example ABCD-EFGH-JKMN-PQRS.

mfa.heading: Confirm the login
mfa.intro: Open your authenticator app and enter the code it shows.
mfa.recoveryIntro: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each code can be used once.
mfa.codeHelp: Six digits. You can paste the code.
mfa.recoveryCodeHelp: It is written as ABCD-EFGH-JKMN-PQRS. Upper and lower case and hyphens do not matter.
mfa.useApp: Use the code from the app
mfa.lowCodes: You have {n} recovery code left. Make new codes as soon as you can, so you are not locked out. | You have {n} recovery codes left. Make new codes as soon as you can, so you are not locked out.

enrol.heading: Set up two-factor authentication
enrol.intro: Your role requires two-factor authentication. Scan the QR code with an authenticator app, or enter the key below. Then enter the code the app shows.
enrol.qrAlt: QR code to add toascribe to your authenticator app
enrol.finishHint: Confirm that you have saved the recovery codes to continue.
enrol.introProfile: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app, or enter the key below. Then enter the code the app shows, and your password.
enrol.passwordHelp: We ask for your password because a new app gives access to your account.

recovery.title: Recovery codes
recovery.intro: We show these codes only now. Use one of them if you lose access to the app. Each code can be used once. Save them somewhere safe.
recovery.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the codes and copy them by hand.

lost.heading: Lost password
lost.intro: Enter your username or email address. If the account exists, we send a link to choose a new password.

choose.introReset: Choose a new password for your account.
choose.introSet: Welcome. Choose a password to start using your account.
choose.help: At least 8 characters. A long password is better than a complicated one.
choose.generated: A new password has been filled in and shown, so you can copy it. Save it in your password manager before you continue.

register.heading: Register
register.closed: This site does not take new users right now. Contact the administrator if you need an account.
register.intro: Enter a username and an email address. We send a link where you choose a password.
register.usernameHelp: 3 to 60 characters: letters and digits, and optionally full stops, underscores, hyphens or {'@'}.

confirm.heading: Confirm the email address
confirm.done: The email address is confirmed. The account now uses {email}.
confirm.adminDone: The site's administration email address is now {email}.

logout.heading: Log out
logout.question: You are attempting to log out of {site}. Do you really want to log out?

bar.helpLabel: Help with this page (opens in a new tab)

name.title: Name
name.displayAsHelp: The name shown in “Howdy, …” and on posts. The choices are made from the names above.

contact.title: Contact Info

about.title: About Yourself
about.bioHelp: Write a few sentences about yourself. The text may be shown publicly.

password.title: New Password
password.intro: If you change your password, your other sessions are logged out.
password.confirmText: Enter the password you use now. We change it and log out your other sessions.

mfa.title: Two-Factor Authentication

mfa.intro: With two-factor authentication you need a code from an app on your phone, as well as your password, when you log in.
mfa.required: Your role requires two-factor authentication. The last app therefore cannot be removed; set up a new one first if you want to switch.
mfa.codesLeft: You have {n} recovery code left. | You have {n} recovery codes left.

general.title: General Settings
general.taglineHelp: In a few words, explain what this site is about.
general.siteUrlHelp: The address is set with PUBLIC_ORIGIN in docker/.env.
general.adminEmailHelp: The address now is {email}. It is used for admin purposes. If you change it, we send an email to the new address, and the new address applies only once it is confirmed.
general.adminEmailPending: Waiting for {email} to be confirmed. The link has been sent there.
general.dateFormatHelp: As in WordPress, for example F j, Y (October 27, 2026) or Y-m-d (2026-10-27).
general.timeFormatHelp: As in WordPress, for example g:i a (2:30 pm).

reading.title: Reading Settings
reading.postsPerRss: Syndication feeds show the most recent
reading.feedShows: For each post in a feed, include
reading.discourage: Discourage search engines from indexing this site
reading.discourageHelp: It is up to search engines to honor this request.
reading.sharingHelp: Used when content is shared on social media and when search engines read the site. The title is “Title – Site Title”, and the front page “Site Title – Tagline”.
reading.defaultImageHelp: Shown when the content has neither its own sharing image nor a featured image. 1200 × 630 pixels works best.
reading.organizationNameHelp: If the field is empty, the site title is used.
reading.organizationLogoHelp: Without a choice of its own, the logo from “Customize” is used.
reading.personHelp: Only users who have published something can be chosen: their author page becomes the person's address.
reading.noPeople: No users have published anything yet.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Choose the page that is the site's privacy policy. It is linked in the footer and on the registration form once it is published.
privacy.pageHelp: A page that is not published is not linked until it is published.
privacy.clickToLoad: Load content from other services only when the reader clicks
privacy.clickToLoadHelp: Videos, music and posts from YouTube, Vimeo, Spotify and others are then shown as a preview with a button. The service does not learn of the visit until the reader clicks.
privacy.mastodonHelp: One address per line, for example mastodon.social. Posts from these instances can be embedded.
privacy.securityHelp: The site shows this at /.well-known/security.txt, so whoever finds a security flaw knows where to report it. Without a contact, the file does not exist.
privacy.securityContactHelp: An email address such as mailto:security{'@'}example.com, or an https address of a form.
privacy.gravatar: Show Gravatar for users without a profile picture
privacy.gravatarHelp: Gravatar is a service outside the site. When this is on, the browser fetches images from it with a code made from the user's email address.

permalinks.title: Permalink Settings
permalinks.intro: Choose how the addresses of your posts look. Old addresses are redirected to the new ones, so links that have been shared keep working.
permalinks.structureHelp: Must contain %postname% or %post_id%. An empty structure is “Plain”.
permalinks.optionalHelp: You may enter custom prefixes for your category and tag URLs. Empty gives category and tag.

updates.title: Updates
updates.loadFailed: The updates could not be loaded.
updates.never: Nobody has looked for new versions yet. The worker checks once a day, or run “toa check-update” on the host.
updates.failed: The last check for new versions failed. The worker tries again tomorrow.
updates.how: The admin cannot update the containers itself. Run this in the folder with compose.yaml on the server:
updates.command:
docker compose pull
docker compose up -d
updates.backupNote: Before the database is changed, toascribe takes a backup and turns on maintenance mode until the changes are done.
updates.checkLabel: Check for new versions once a day
updates.checkHelp: The worker fetches the list of published versions from ghcr.io. Nothing about the site is sent.
updates.offByServer: The check is turned off on the server (TOASCRIBE_UPDATE_CHECK=off).

siteHealth.title: Site Health
siteHealth.loadFailed: The information could not be loaded.
siteHealth.intro: Facts about the installation, for troubleshooting. The copy to the clipboard hides email addresses, addresses, paths and anything that looks like a key, so you can paste it into a request for help.
siteHealth.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
siteHealth.debugOn: Debug mode is on (TOASCRIBE_DEBUG=1). The logs get more detail. Turn it off when the troubleshooting is done.
